profile.tagline: Powered by curiosity and Ctrl + Z.
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineering graduate from Sabah with one dream — to build my career, live, and one day own a home in Kuala Lumpur. I love creating websites, improving existing features, and turning new ideas into real products. Curious by nature, I'm always learning new technologies and excited to contribute to real-world projects that make a meaningful impact.

project0.description: A full-stack web application for browsing, purchasing, and managing purebred pets. Customers can search pets, book appointments, and purchase pets. Administrators manage pets, appointments, inventory, sales reports, and riders through a comprehensive dashboard. The system also integrates AI-powered pet breed recognition using a ResNet50 deep learning model.
